title: The Equality Act 2010 (Code of Practice on Services, Public Functions and Associations) (Commencement) Order 2026
summary: This instrument brings into force the Commission for Equality and Human Rights’ Code of Practice on Services, Public Functions and Associations (“the 2026 Code of Practice”).

The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Cardiff) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Dovestones Reservoir, Manchester) (Emergency) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Dovestones Reservoir, Manchester) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Calculation of CBAM Rate and Determination of Carbon Price Relief) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the introduction of a new tax called the carbon border adjustment mechanism (“CBAM”). CBAM was introduced by Part 5 of the Finance Act 2026 (“FA 2026”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Dovestones Reservoir, Manchester) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Digital Communications and Contact Details Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about the use of electronic communications by His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (“HMRC”) and the provision of digital contact details to HMRC by persons using online services provided by HMRC.

title: The Finance Act 2026 (Registration of Tax Advisers) (Appointed Days and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations appoint the days on which Chapter 1 of Part 7 of the Finance Act 2026, which provides for the registration of tax advisers, comes into force. The Regulations also make transitional provision for tax advisers who have an Agent Services Account immediately before 18th August 2026, so that they are treated as registered for the purposes of those provisions from that date.

title: The Customs Tariff (Suspension of Import Duty Rates) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Customs Tariff (Suspension of Import Duty Rates) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/1435) (“the 2020 SI”). Regulation 2(2) amends the definition of “Suspensions of Import Duty Rates Document” in regulation 2 of the 2020 SI to refer to a new version of that document. The new version of that document has been revised to implement new suspensions granted as a result of the 2025 to 2026 application window for business suspensions. This new version of the document also makes routine technical and descriptive updates, and corrects minor errors.

title: The Terrorism (Protection of Premises) (Notification Requirements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in relation to the information which must be provided to the Security Industry Authority by a person who is, or has been, responsible for qualifying premises or a qualifying event under section 9 of the Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025 (c. 10) (“the Act”).

title: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Administrative Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with a new tax called the carbon border adjustment mechanism (“CBAM”), which is provided for in Part 5 of the Finance Act 2026 (“FA 2026”).

title: The Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (Commencement No. 2) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (c. 21) (“the Act”). They are the second commencement regulations to be made under the Act which bring into force provisions of the Act in relation to England only.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Saltby) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Rotherham, South Yorkshire) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Register of Overseas Entities (Protection and Trusts) and Limited Liability Partnerships (Application of Company Law) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Register of Overseas Entities (Delivery, Protection and Trust Services) Regulations 2022 (S.I. 2022/870) (“the 2022 Regulations”) and the Register of Overseas Entities (Protection and Trusts) (Amendment) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/231) (“the 2025 Regulations”) in relation to the register of overseas entities kept by the registrar of companies for England and Wales. These Regulations also amend the Limited Liability Partnerships (Application of Companies Act 2006) Regulations 2009 (S.I. 2009/1084) (“the 2009 Regulations”).

title: The Civil Nuclear Constabulary (Barred List and Advisory List) Regulations 2026
summary: Schedule 25 to the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (Special police forces: barred person lists and advisory lists) requires the Civil Nuclear Police Authority (“the Authority”) to maintain a “barred persons list” and an “advisory list” (as defined in paragraph 14 of that Schedule). These Regulations make provision relating to the operation of those lists.

The Licensing Act 2003 (FIFA World Cup Licensing Hours) (Amendment) (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Licensing Act 2003 (FIFA World Cup Licensing Hours) Order 2026 (“the 2026 Order”) to make further provision in connection with the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
